description: This file contains functions and logic for composing emails within SuiteCRM, including generating email data packages, initializing compose windows, and handling reply/forward actions.

methods.name: initFullCompose
methods.description: Initializes the full compose window by encoding the compose data package and including it in a script or returning it for AJAX calls.

methods.name: generateComposeDataPackage
methods.description: Generates the data package for email composition, handling various contexts such as new emails, replies, forwards, and related records.

methods.name: getQuotesRelatedData
methods.description: Retrieves related data for quote records to prepopulate email fields.
